{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
# The value -999.0 appears in the data and is likely a sentinel for missing or invalid data
print("Sentinel value -999.0 appears in biomarker_baseline:")
print(data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0])

# Count how many patients have -999.0 in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()
print(f"Number of patients with sentinel value -999.0: {sentinel_count}")

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = data[data['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check if any of the severe patients have sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
severe_with_sentinel = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]
print(f"Number of SEVERE patients with sentinel value -999.0: {len(severe_with_sentinel)}")

# Calculate mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients, excluding sentinel values
severe_valid_biomarker = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline']
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_valid_biomarker.mean()

print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients (excluding sentinel values): {mean_biomarker_severe}")"}
